legs.summary: Access requires BOTH halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion — right half from Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia), left half from Castle Sol. At the Grand Lift of Rold, select 'Hoist secret medallion' to reach the hidden path. Collect the map fragment on the road through the blizzard, then push north to Inner Consecrated Snowfield.

steps.text: PREREQUISITE: You need BOTH Haligtree Secret Medallion halves. Right half from Old Albus at Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia). Left half from the northeast tower of Castle Sol after defeating Commander Niall. At the Grand Lift of Rold, select 'Hoist secret medallion' (not the standard Rold Medallion).

steps.note: Follow the road north past the initial blizzard zone until you descend and cross a frozen river — the stele is on the road.

legs.summary: West sweep before Ordina: the Night's Cavalry caravan at night drops the full armor set, the enemy caravan contains the Flowing Curved Sword and St. Trina's Torch. The Sanguine Noble invader near Yelough Anix Ruins activates the Mohgwyn teleporter and drops the Sanguine Noble armor set. Rotten Duelists near Ordina drop the Rotten Greataxe.

steps.text: ALTERNATE Mohgwyn Access (non-Varré route): Near Yelough Anix Ruins in the far west, defeat the Sanguine Noble NPC invader to activate the waygate on the western cliffs. This is the only way to reach Mohgwyn Palace if you did not complete Varré's questline.

legs.summary: Ordina's evergaol puzzle unlocks the portal to Miquella's Haligtree. Then ride northeast to the Apostate Derelict to conclude Latenna's questline and collect dungeon rewards from Cave of the Forlorn and Yelough Anix Tunnel.

steps.text: ORDINA PUZZLE: Interact with the Sending Gate in Ordina to enter the evergaol. Activate four torch statues scattered across the rooftops and ground level. Invisible Black Knife Assassins guard the area — the Sentry's Torch (bought from a merchant) makes them visible. Once all four flames are lit, the waygate at the town's center activates and opens passage to Miquella's Haligtree.

steps.note: Found under an arch in Ordina, Liturgical Town.

steps.text: Travel to Apostate Derelict in the far north of the Consecrated Snowfield. Summon Latenna using her Spirit Ash — she delivers the birthing droplet to the giant Albinauric woman Phillia, completing her quest.

missable.note: Latenna must have been met at Slumbering Wolf's Shack (after Lakeside Crystal Cave) and shown the Haligtree Medallion Right half. If she was not spoken to, she is dead and her quest cannot be completed (though her ashes can still be collected).
